# Otto's Journal — Backlog & Project Organization Learnings

## 2026-09-16 - Automated Security Alert Grouping Issues **Learning:** Security alert issues (e.g., #152, #114, #81, #80) generated by repository workflows contain specific HTML comment identifiers (`<!-- fullstacktemplate-security-alert:... -->`) that tie them to automated project sync workflows. **Action:** Avoid manually modifying or closing security alert group issues unless the underlying vulnerabilities are conclusively resolved or workflow parameters change, as automated synchronization relies on these exact issue identifiers and structures.
